    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">C#/.NET/.NET Core优秀项目和框架2025年10月简报</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202511/1336199-20251107032446252-1595148118.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>前言</span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>公众号每月定期推广和分享的C#/.NET/.NET Core优秀项目和框架（每周至少会推荐两个优秀的项目和框架当然节假日除外），公众号推文中有项目和框架的详细介绍、功能特点、使用方式以及部分功能截图等（打不开或者打开GitHub很慢的同学可以优先查看公众号推文，文末一定会附带项目和框架源码地址）。注意：排名不分先后，都是十分优秀的开源项目和框架，每周定期更新分享（欢迎关注公众号：<strong>追逐时光者</strong><span>，第一时间获取每周精选分享资讯🔔）。</span></span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>💡简报Gitee开源地址：https://gitee.com/ysgdaydayup/DotNetGuide/blob/main/docs/DotNet/DotNetProjectMonthly.md</strong></li>
<li><strong>🔔简报GitHub开源地址：https://github.com/YSGStudyHards/DotNetGuide/blob/main/docs/DotNet/DotNetProjectMonthly.md</strong></li>
</ul>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>Mapster</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;Mapster 是一个开源免费（MIT license）、快速、高性能、灵活且易于使用的 .NET 对象映射库，用于在 .NET 用程序中进行对象之间的转换和映射操作，大幅减少手动赋值带来的重复代码、人为错误和维护成本。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong><span>&nbsp;https://github.com/MapsterMapper/Mapster</span></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247517620&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=f1b141548a56586b091fd891efa68131&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/QFEbHE2EWzzZN9VvnUwD4A</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202511/1336199-20251107032506461-1663251106.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>TDS</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;TDS 是一款基于 .NET 开源免费（MIT license）、高效且用户友好的文件搜索工具，使用 Avalonia UI 技术并完美支持 AOT 编译，实现并优化了如 USN 读取/近实时更新，索引磁盘缓存，索引增强搜索，多关键字匹配，多线程搜索，Avalonia UI 实现(虚拟化,全局热键,系统托盘)等功能，具有轻量高效、界面美观、交互舒适等特性。该项目以 MIT 协议开源免费，可供学习参考或自定义扩展。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong><span>&nbsp;https://github.com/LdotJdot/TDS</span></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247517316&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=3631c54b18448ed9eca2eab84291f13e&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/RBu3nCNkMN76bPdjc-h5Gg</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202511/1336199-20251107032520970-1462669122.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202511/1336199-20251107032525217-677506130.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>Purest Admin</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;Purest Admin 是一个基于 .NET 8 + Vue3 实现的前后端分离、极简 RABC 权限管理系统，基于 LGPL-3.0 协议开源，后端在 ABP 框架的设计上进行了精简和改良，前端基于 vue-pure-admin，前端极强的表格框架 vxe-table，旨在为 .NET 开发者提供一套简洁、高效、可扩展的快速开发解决方案。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong><span>&nbsp;https://github.com/dymproject/purest-admin</span></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247517737&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=aa5590acb6f5a3521be3bd513ee1f6c0&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/osVxMjuhGeAyr7V8V6mRFw</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202511/1336199-20251107032536897-1317046902.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202511/1336199-20251107032541364-1398234698.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>Anno.Core</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;Anno.Core 是一个基于 .NET 开源、功能强大的分布式微服务开发框架，致力于简化分布式、微服务系统的构建。框架原生支持 gRPC 和 Thrift 两种高性能 RPC 通信协议，自带服务发现、调用链追踪、Cron 调度、限流、事件总线、CQRS 、DDD、插件化开发等。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong><span>&nbsp;https://github.com/duyanming/Anno.Core</span></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247517675&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=95183ed631bdc0590916493bf4870e3f&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/fVITS8MjAyM9mLdtSN0rcg</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202511/1336199-20251107032602038-1535569380.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>Viper</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;Viper 是一个基于 Anno.Core 微服务引擎开发的 Dashboard 项目、示例项目。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong><span>&nbsp;https://github.com/duyanming/Viper</span></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247517675&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=95183ed631bdc0590916493bf4870e3f&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/fVITS8MjAyM9mLdtSN0rcg</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202511/1336199-20251107032615611-1461224169.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202511/1336199-20251107032620131-734770221.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>ColorPicker</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;ColorPicker 是一款适用于 WPF 和 AvaloniaUI 的可定制颜色选择器控件，支持 RGB、HSV、HSL 等多种色彩模式，能够轻松集成到你的 .NET 桌面应用中，为用户提供流畅精准的选色体验。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong><span>&nbsp;https://github.com/PixiEditor/ColorPicker</span></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247517878&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=ebb896b9d353530e642c6648702ca24f&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/MgcbJG9BkFfTp9Pc5oduTg</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202511/1336199-20251107032633380-1373558475.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>PowerToolbox</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;PowerToolbox 是一款由 .NET 开源免费（MIT License）、轻量、界面简洁、多功能 Windows 工具箱，包含摸鱼工具、文件工具、资源工具、个性化工具、系统工具等多个功能。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong><span>&nbsp;https://github.com/Gaoyifei1011/PowerToolbox</span></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247517780&amp;idx=2&amp;sn=ef34bd9e3c14705e84e3d7f45f220310&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/prSiGEeFPFvtTCXFfhRROQ</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202511/1336199-20251107032645298-63935839.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202511/1336199-20251107032651025-1172476876.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>Aura.UI</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;Aura.UI 是一个开源免费（MIT license）、轻量级的 Avalonia UI 控件库。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong><span>&nbsp;https://github.com/PieroCastillo/Aura.UI</span></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247517819&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=799e103d307e9020d1139812e238fcaf&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/CNrat3lg7t8_ii_jrHe_xQ</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202511/1336199-20251107032704357-1525611941.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
